answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network auctions 50 entry slots; applicants bid a ferrous bond. Slots clear at 80 copper, locked 20 epochs and returned for honest service only; a caught fake forfeits its bond. A farm wanting 100 fakes pays 8,000 copper up front, while an honest agent pays 80 once and keeps its full reward, a pearl earned by staying clean. The chain is heavy in bulk and light alone, and no ledge holds a second identity unpaid.
